outcome: Neonatal intensive and special care admissions
cohort: The study included 83 women who delivered 86 infants following bariatric surgery at an Australian quaternary public hospital between June 2016 and February 2021.
finding: Adherence to general antenatal monitoring guidelines was high, but compliance with additional, bariatric-surgery-specific monitoring recommendations was lower, correlating with significantly higher rates of adverse infant outcomes compared to the general population.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were significantly higher in the post-bariatric surgery group compared to the Queensland and Australian populations.
